(program
  (variable_assignment name: (variable_name) @binding
    value: (command_substitution . [
      (command name: (command_name (word) @producer) !redirect)
      (redirected_statement
        body: (command name: (command_name (word) @producer) !redirect)
        . redirect: (file_redirect) @stderr .)
    ] .))
  . [
    (pipeline
      . (command name: (command_name (word) @printf) !redirect
        . argument: [(raw_string) (string . (string_content) .)] @format
        . argument: (string . (simple_expansion (variable_name) @used) .) .)
      . (command name: (command_name (word) @curl) !redirect
        . argument: (word)* @flags
        . ((word) @timeout . (number))?
        . argument: (word) @data
        . argument: [(word) (raw_string) (string . (string_content) .)] @stdin
        . argument: [(word) (raw_string) (string . (string_content) .)] @url .) .)
    (if_statement
      condition: (test_command . (unary_expression
        operator: (test_operator) @nonempty
        . (string . (simple_expansion (variable_name)) .) .) .)
      "then" . (pipeline
        . (command name: (command_name (word) @printf) !redirect
          . argument: [(raw_string) (string . (string_content) .)] @format
          . argument: (string . (simple_expansion (variable_name) @used) .) .)
        . (command name: (command_name (word) @curl) !redirect
          . argument: (word)* @flags
          . ((word) @timeout . (number))?
          . argument: (word) @data
          . argument: [(word) (raw_string) (string . (string_content) .)] @stdin
          . argument: [(word) (raw_string) (string . (string_content) .)] @url .) .)
      . "fi")
  ]
  (#match? @stderr "^2[ \\t]*>[ \\t]*/dev/null$")
  (#eq? @printf "printf")
  (#match? @format "^['\"]%s['\"]$")
  (#eq? @used @binding)
  (#eq? @nonempty "-n")
  (#match? @curl "^(/usr/bin/)?curl$")
  (#match? @flags "^-[fsSLsv]+$")
  (#match? @timeout "^(-m|--max-time)$")
  (#match? @data "^(-d|--data(-binary)?)$")
  (#match? @stdin "^['\"]?@-['\"]?$")
  (#match? @url "^['\"]?https?://[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9.-]*\\.[A-Za-z]{2,}[:/]")
  (#not-match? @url "(?i)\\.localhost[:/]"))
